name: Physical Capability Cloud
description: Verifiable on-chain skill wrapper for any physical capability. Discover, price, and orchestrate manufacturing capabilities — 3D printing, CNC machining, HPLC analysis, and more.

endpoints.description: List all physical capability types on the PCC network (FDM printing, SLA printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, HPLC analysis, mass spectrometry, PCB assembly, injection molding)
Search for capability templates — find machines that can do what you need, with pricing and assurance tier info

query.description: What capability you need, e.g. 'HPLC purity analysis' or '3D print in PLA'

endpoints.description: Get configuration options for a capability — materials, dimensions, tolerances, and other parameters
Calculate real-time price for a capability configuration using Meteora DLMM pools
Build and submit a manufacturing contract with milestone escrow on Base Sepolia
List all Shop Kernels — physical manufacturing sites with equipment, status, and capabilities
Get detailed Shop Kernel info — devices, queue depth, capability certificates
List all active and completed manufacturing jobs with status and progress
Get job details — progress, evidence timeline, escrow status, sensor data
List all milestone escrow contracts — amounts locked, challenge windows, bond status
Get escrow details — milestones, bonds, challenge windows, dispute status
List encrypted evidence bundles — Lit Protocol encrypted, IPFS stored, Bittensor verified
Browse protocol templates — reusable multi-step manufacturing workflows as DAGs
Equipment marketplace — demand/supply charts, equipment classes, ROI data
Operator dashboard — machines, earnings, capability certificates, maintenance schedules
DePIN reward statistics — treasury balance, soulbound certificates, epoch rewards, claim status
Bittensor verification subnet status — miner health, leaderboard, consensus scores
Logistics hub — shipments, installations, space bookings for physical equipment
